name: transcription factor EB

function.text: TFEB encodes transcription factor EB. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include TFEB-altered renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
